stem: How did the Supreme Court decision in Worcester v. Georgia affect American Indians?

options.label: A
options.text: The ruling gave the state authority over relations with American Indians.

options.label: B
options.text: The state ignored the ruling and distributed Cherokee lands to white settlers.

options.label: C
options.text: More American Indian tribes decided to grant licenses to missionaries to live on tribal lands.

options.label: D
options.text: Reservation policies were overturned and replaced with land grants to individuals.
